description: This class implements the TaxClassService interface, providing methods to manage TaxClass entities such as listing by store, retrieving by code, and deleting tax classes. It interacts with the TaxClassDao for data persistence and extends a generic service implementation.

classes.name: TaxClassServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the TaxClassService interface, providing business logic for managing TaxClass entities, including retrieval, deletion, and listing by store.

methods.name: TaxClassServiceImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the service with a TaxClassDao and passes it to the superclass.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxClass objects associated with a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code.

methods.name: getByCode (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass by its code within a specific MerchantStore.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a given TaxClass entity after retrieving it by ID.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxClass entity by its ID.
